meaning:
ὀψάριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of ὄψον, (1) cooked meat; (2) a relish or dainty, esp. fish, cf. MGr. τὸ ψάρι, fish; in comic poets and late prose writers only) [in LXX: Tob.2:2 א (Β, ὄψον)* ;]
fish: Jhn.6:9, 11 21:9-10, 13 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
